tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Modals of deduction (present): must = I'm sure it's true (He must be hungry). might / could / may = it's possible (It might be a spell). can't = I'm sure it's not true (That can't be a real spell). Past: must have / might have / can't have + past participle (He must have lost his toad).

s2.q_pl: Ron: Right! And who's the boy who keeps losing his toad? (Ron: Dobrze! A kim jest chłopiec, który ciągle gubi ropuchę?)

s3.q: Ron: And the girl who knows all the books?

choices.t: It might be Hermione, but I'm not sure.

s4.q: Ron: And a rat that sleeps twenty hours a day?

choices.t: It can't be anyone but Scabbers!

end_good.title: Місію виконано!
end_good.text: Рон сміється: «Ти, мабуть, найкращий у цій грі!» Потяг сповільнюється.
end_good.text_pl: Ron się śmieje: „Musisz być najlepszy w tej grze!” Pociąg zwalnia.
end_good.text_en: Ron laughs: “You must be the best at this game!” The train is slowing down.
